Class PathHistoryStore

  • java.lang.Object
    • gui.PathHistoryStore

  • final class PathHistoryStore
extends java.lang.Object
    Manages persistent user configuration settings across application sessions using a simple key-value configuration file. The settings file is stored in the user's home directory and maintains the most recently used source and target paths, together with a limited history of recent source entries.

      • saveSettings

        static void saveSettings(javafx.scene.control.TextField sourceText,
                         javafx.scene.control.TextField targetText)
                  throws java.io.IOException
        Saves the current source and target paths to the persistent settings file and updates the recent history. When possible, the source's absolute parent directory is determined from the source field's tooltip or from one of its absolute paths. For multiple source files, the parent directory is stored together with the source list using a pipe delimiter.
        Parameters:
        sourceText - the text field containing the source path or paths
        targetText - the text field containing the target path
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if the settings file cannot be read or written

      • loadSettings

        static void loadSettings(javafx.scene.control.TextField sourceText,
                         javafx.scene.control.TextField targetText)
                  throws java.io.IOException
        Loads the previously saved source and target paths into the supplied text fields. A source entry stored in pipe-delimited form is unpacked so that the source text and its parent directory can be restored separately. The restored parent directory is stored in the source field's tooltip.
        Parameters:
        sourceText - the text field into which the saved source path or paths are loaded
        targetText - the text field into which the saved target path is loaded
        Throws:
        java.io.IOException - if the settings file cannot be read
